creators: PolyAI; Iñigo Casanueva, Tadas Temcinas, Daniela Gerz, Matthew Henderson, Ivan Vulić
paper: Efficient Intent Detection with Dual Sentence Encoders (2020)
modifications: Queries sampled with fixed seeds; unchanged query text; original 77 fine-grained intent labels mapped to five coarse support queues. This is not a report of full 77-intent accuracy.
source_integrity: Full train/test CSV snapshots and SHA-256 values retained in dataset.json; official split sizes verified as 10003 train and 3080 test.
